local.message: apply_prescription_persurface_to_beamlets: the prescription's LAST surface is a MIRROR, and the local-frame branch cannot serve a mirror-terminated prescription.  Its image-side leg is built from Nz2 = 1/sqrt(1 + ux^2 + uy^2), which is positive whatever the true N, so after a mirror the returned direction, the leg t = z_image/Nz2 and the Moebius free-space step all run along +z while the light travels toward -z (measured VERIFY-WP-B12b sec. 9.2: the spot RMS is 7.8e3 x the traced one at z_image = +f, and at z_image = -f the transverse positions are right but the leg piston carries the wrong sign, 0.48 waves).  NO ROUTE IN THIS LIBRARY SERVES THIS CLASS YET when the mirror is CURVED: world_output_plane refuses a powered terminating fold itself.  For a FLAT terminating mirror, pass world_output_plane=(p0, R_out) -- an explicit plane, since 'auto' has no paraxial focus to find.  Otherwise propagate to the mirror and continue the reverse leg yourself.  Refusing rather than returning a wrong field silently.
